catches: Each brand offer is generally limited to one redemption per user; each offer quotes its own reimbursement cap (the documented Wilde offer caps at $3.50).
You must purchase the exact qualifying product at a local retailer before claiming.
Receipt photo must clearly show the purchase; invalid receipts are rejected.
Reimbursement arrives via Venmo or PayPal only — you need one of those accounts.
Offers vary by location and change frequently; limited quantities per offer.
Frequent marketing text messages are part of the program (consent required at signup).

steps: Go to the Aisle offers page and enter your phone number and ZIP code.
Claim the brand offers you want before shopping.
Buy the exact qualifying product(s) at a local retailer and keep the receipt.
Text a photo of the receipt to the number Aisle gives you.
Receive the reimbursement via Venmo or PayPal, typically within 24 hours.
Repeat with each new offer — each brand offer is a fresh payout.
timing: Reimbursement via Venmo or PayPal within 24 hours of receipt approval; homepage describes payment as instant.
who_pays: Aisle pays you — they reimburse your grocery purchase out of the brand partnerships behind each offer. The money lands as real cash in your Venmo or PayPal account.
who_qualifies: US shoppers with a phone number and a Venmo or PayPal account. Offers vary by ZIP code — what's available depends on your location.
work_available: Yes — Aisle runs brand offers on an ongoing basis, but each offer has limited quantities and can change or sell out; every offer page states its own reimbursement cap and terms. Check the current offers before shopping, since new brands rotate in regularly.
what_gets_accepted: You must buy the exact qualifying product at a local retailer and text a receipt photo that clearly shows the purchase — invalid or unreadable receipts are rejected. Each brand offer is one redemption per user.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fee to join. But you buy the product first with your own money — the $3.50 comes back to you afterward, so this is savings on groceries you'd buy anyway, not income. Budget 10–20 minutes to claim the offer, shop, and text the receipt photo.
when_cash_arrives: Reimbursement arrives via Venmo or PayPal, officially "within 24 hours" of receipt approval — the Aisle homepage describes it as instant.
